identificationModule.briefTitle: A Study of Abemaciclib (LY2835219) in Participants With Previously Treated KRAS Mutated Lung Cancer
identificationModule.officialTitle: JUNIPER: A Randomized Phase 3 Study of Abemaciclib Plus Best Supportive Care Versus Erlotinib Plus Best Supportive Care in Patients With Stage IV NSCLC With a Detectable KRAS Mutation Who Have Progressed After Platinum-Based Chemotherapy

armGroups.label: Abemaciclib
armGroups.description: 200 milligrams (mg) abemaciclib administered, orally, every 12 hours plus best supportive care (BSC) on Days 1 to 28 (28 day cycles).

armGroups.label: Erlotinib
armGroups.description: 150 mg erlotinib administered, orally, every 24 hours plus BSC on Days 1 to 28 (28 day cycles).
